versions.changelog: 描述优化：一句话非技术描述

- Initial release of apollo-overview, an AI coding methodology suite adapted natively for OpenClaw.
- Provides a structured, spec-first, TDD-driven workflow covering ideation, specification, planning, execution, review, and delivery.
- Features full Chinese language support, subagent-driven task management, and systematic debugging tools.
- Offers automatic semantic triggers for various development tasks, including brainstorming, planning, implementation, debugging, and code review.
- Includes detailed explanation of workflow, core principles, and usage examples.
